name: Ibrahim Al-Rashid
bio: Patriarch of the Al-Rashid family. Migrated from Lahore to Delhi in 1905. Known for his scholarship in classical Arabic and Persian literature.

name: Fatima Begum
bio: Matriarch of the family. Renowned for her knowledge of herbal medicine and her role in the community as an educator of young women.

name: Yusuf Al-Rashid
bio: Eldest son of Ibrahim. Served as a civil officer during the transition period. Settled in Karachi after partition.

name: Zainab Noor
bio: Married into the Al-Rashid family in 1932. Known for her poetry, some of which was published in Urdu literary journals of the era.

name: Maryam Al-Rashid
bio: Daughter of Ibrahim. Became a teacher and never married by choice. Dedicated her life to education in rural areas.

name: Hassan Al-Rashid
bio: Son of Yusuf. Engineer by profession. Lived in Karachi until 1985, then moved to Toronto.

name: Amina Siddiqui
bio: Wife of Hassan. Active community organiser in the Pakistani diaspora in Toronto.

name: Omar Al-Rashid
bio: Second son of Yusuf. Worked as a journalist and editor for a prominent Urdu newspaper in Karachi.

name: Ruqayyah Khan
bio: Wife of Omar. Retired school principal.

name: Layla Al-Rashid
bio: Daughter of Hassan and Amina. Software engineer based in Toronto. Passionate about preserving family heritage through technology.

name: Khalid Al-Rashid
bio: Son of Hassan and Amina. Physician specialising in cardiology. Lives in London.

name: Sana Mirza
bio: Wife of Khalid. Architect and urban planner.

name: Zaid Al-Rashid
bio: Son of Omar. Academic researcher specialising in South Asian history.

name: Noor Al-Rashid
bio: Daughter of Omar and Ruqayyah. Journalist and documentary filmmaker.

name: Adam Al-Rashid
bio: Son of Khalid and Sana. Medical student in London.

name: Sara Al-Rashid
bio: Daughter of Khalid and Sana. Architecture student, following in her mother's footsteps.
